prompt: Create a clean orthographic stair-view atlas in transparent background with exactly THREE columns and TWO rows. Column headings left to right: FRONT, TOP, REAR. Row1 exact UP stair; row2 exact DOWN stair. Preserve the deep red carpet treads, dark wood risers/frame, four brass ball-capped corner posts, palette and proportions. FRONT level straight-on shows upright vertical riser faces as repeated horizontal bands, not foreshortened carpet tread planes. TOP is true vertical overhead: red horizontal tread surfaces in a step sequence, only small post-cap footprints at four corners, no shafts/front facade. REAR is structural back elevation: flat dark-wood panel/frame, no carpet tread planes. Strict orthographic, no isometric/perspective, no shadows/scenery/additions.
output_mapping: 3 columns x 2 rows, row-major FRONT/TOP/REAR; exact cell bounds and extraction details are recorded per generated view in the staged report.
candidate_output_policy: Only FRONT/TOP/REAR are staged; RIGHT/LEFT/BOTTOM remain current exact files.
